parts.text:
A four-panel storyboard strip illustration in glossy 3D clay sticker style, panels separated by thin dark gutters.
Panel one: a small glowing violet orb alone in darkness with faint rings. Panel two: the orb brighter with dozens of tiny cyan and mint motes spiralling inward. Panel three: a soft creature silhouette (rounded teardrop body, antenna stalk with an orb tip) resolving from the light, still translucent. Panel four: the finished creature companion in soft teal-aqua (#74D6C8) with two dot eyes, a tiny smile, foot nubs, bubble speckles and a bright white die-cut sticker outline, slightly tilted as if peeling forward off the sky.
Deep navy space background (#0B1030) in every panel with a faint aurora glow and star specks; a soft glowing ring on the floor under the creature in panels three and four.
Consistent camera and scale across all four panels, centered subject, additive glow that never blows out, clearcoat gloss on the final creature, 16:9.
Style anchor: Glossy 3D clay sticker style in the Arise Soul sticker language: chibi bell / gumdrop bodies with two soft foot nubs, an antenna stalk topped by a glowing orb, big soft top highlight, warm peach rim light, bubble speckles in two sizes (mint #7CF5C8, cyan #63E6FF, lilac #8B7CF0), a thick white die-cut sticker outline with a soft drop shadow.
Sky: Deep navy space background (#0B1030 to #151C48) with a slow aurora band drifting from teal #4FE3C1 to lime #B6FF5C and tiny star specks.
The same creature in every panel, same size. No human face, no text, no numbers, no labels, no level or rank marks, no logos, no watermark.
No human face or human likeness of any kind. No text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, logos or watermarks. No level, rank, tier, score, XP or badge labels. All figures are the same size and brightness; nothing looks stronger or more important than anything else.
